example: The report uses excitable to explain an important part of the issue in a formal context.
example_zh: 這份報告用 excitable 來說明正式語境中該議題的重要部分。

near_synonyms.difference: aspect is broader and more general; excitable is used as a more specific vocabulary item.
factor emphasizes influence in a system, while excitable follows its own lexical meaning and usage pattern.

usage_note: excitable is intended for college-level vocabulary study; review the collocations before using it in writing.
